label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (inflammatory-high)
description: Cluster 0 is epithelial, leaning toward differentiated squamous epithelium. Squamous differentiation metagenes M69 (CRNN, KLK13, KRT23, CNFN), M65 (KRT13, KRT4, PPL, SCEL, EVPL), M28 (PI3, KRT24, TGM1, IVL) and M18 (KRT24, TGM1, PPL, EVPL) carry the top genes CRNN, KRT24, PPL, KLK13, CLCA4 and PI3, and basal markers KRT5/KRT14 are absent. Glandular/secretory M20 (MUC1, CEACAM7, PSCA) and tumor-leaning M32 and M42 add a secondary epithelial component. S100A8/S100A9 (M0, M70, M28) form a modest inflammatory or neutrophil signal of about 2-3% of counts, treated as background spillover rather than a distinct lineage. Confidence is medium because the squamous signal is strong but the lineage is not sharply separated from tumor or glandular epithelium.
cell_types: Differentiated squamous epithelial cells, Tumor epithelial cells
metagene_label: Differentiated squamous epithelium, S100A8/A9-high + Glandular secretory epithelium program

label: Low-quality technical signal (weak epithelial)
description: Cluster 1 (580 cells) has no clear lineage. Its composition is dominated by technical or diffuse factors: M30 (OR4F17/IST1, 14.9% share, technical) and M2 (SIGLEC15/GOLGA6L4 multi-copy families, 11.7%, ambiguous), together with diffuse background factors M45, M56 and M98. Weak epithelial-like and stress signals appear (M51 TMPRSS2/KRT13, M61 SAT1/ERO1A, M16 MDM2/CLDN1, M54 p53/MUC16 secretory), and squamous differentiation (M37, FLG/CRNN/IVL, 1.6%) and a basal-like KRT15 factor (M10) are minor. Myeloid M14 is only 1.9% and present in few cells, so it is not a true myeloid cluster. The top genes are mostly OR4F17, IST1, SAT1 and ERO1A, which are probe or stress artifacts. This is most likely a low-quality cluster dominated by technical signal, with at most a weak tumor-epithelial or squamous component.

label: Regulatory T cells (mixed with CD8 T cells)
description: Cluster 2 is a T-cell cluster: M29 (T cell core: CD3E, TRAC, TRBC2, CD3D, CD2, BCL11B) and M83 (regulatory T cell: FOXP3, CTLA4, IL2RA, ICOS, TIGIT) carry the identity, with top genes TRAC, CD3E, TRBC1, CTLA4, CD3D and CD2 confirming it. M83 is in 41% of cells at 10.5% share, so the cluster leans toward Tregs with conventional T cells mixed in. CD8 cytotoxic signal (M93, 5%, 24% of cells) suggests some CD8/NK-like cells. Remaining metagenes (M8, M13, M89, M60, M2, M64, M58, M94) are diffuse nuclear/background factors with no lineage, and M79 and M9 are weak interferon/lymphoid factors; none is a meaningful contaminant.
cell_types: Regulatory T cells, CD4 T cells, CD8 T cells
metagene_label: T cell markers + Regulatory T cell markers

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium, inflamed (hypoxic)
description: Cluster 3 is a keratinizing squamous epithelial population with superficial, granular-layer and cornification signal, plus hypoxia and inflammatory overlay. Its strongest factor M37 (squamous differentiation with S100A8 and hypoxia genes) carries 18.8% of counts in 56% of cells, supported by top genes FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL, ERO1A, KRT13 and S100A8/S100A9. Cornification factors M15 and M69 (IVL, SBSN, TGM1, CRNN, KLK13) reinforce a differentiated squamous identity, with M11 hypoxia (SLC2A1, NDRG1, CA9) adding a moderate share in about 23% of cells. Neutrophil-like S100A8/S100A9 is present but mostly in shared squamous factors, and no clear immune lineage markers appear among top genes. Basal markers KRT5 and KRT14 are absent, so the call leans toward suprabasal or superficial cells. Diffuse factors (M57, M98, M48) are background. Interferon (M52) is weak.

label: Weak stromal signal (fibroblast/smooth muscle)
description: Cluster 4 is mostly diffuse background. The top genes (GNAS, NPM1, PTMA, DAZAP2, TPT1, RACK1) are broadly expressed housekeeping and RNA-processing genes, and the dominant metagenes M64, M58 and M43 have no lineage theme. The only lineage signal is weak stromal: fibroblast ECM M4 (4.1% share, 15% of cells, 1.8x fold) and smooth muscle/myofibroblast M19 (4.0%, 10% of cells, 2.6x), with SFRP4 and CCN2 among the enriched top genes. Immune and epithelial markers are negligible, so the cluster is best read as low-signal stroma with no confident cell type.

label: B cells (germinal center-like subset)
description: Cluster 5 is dominated by a clean B-cell program: M34 (B cell markers, 16.5% share, in 81% of cells, fold 84x) with MS4A1, BANK1, BLK, CD79A, CD22, IRF8 and POU2AF1 among the top genes. M33 (germinal center B cells, 6.4% share, in 13% of cells, fold 72x) adds CXCL13, CR2, GCSAM, AICDA and RGS13, suggesting a follicular/germinal-center B subset within lymphoid aggregates. M79 (FCMR/SELL/TRIM22, 9.9%) is a broad lymphocyte/interferon-tinged factor without lineage-specific core markers, and the remaining metagenes (M8, M13, M9, M2, M60, M89, M64, M58) are diffuse nuclear or housekeeping background with no lineage. No clear myeloid or stromal contamination; M14 (myeloid, 2%) is minor and mostly enriched in cluster 20.
cell_types: B cells, Germinal center B cells

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium, S100A8/A9-high
description: Cluster 6 is a squamous epithelial/tumor cell cluster in cervical cancer. The top genes are squamous and desmosomal markers (PERP, KRT13, DSP, KRT5, CALML3, SERPINB13, DSG3, CD24, DSC2, KLK10/11, KRT24), supported by M5 (squamous KRT13/DSP-high), M6 (squamous differentiation with hypoxia genes), M0 (differentiated squamous with S100A8/A9-high), and M18 (squamous differentiation). S100A8/S100A9 are among the top genes but the squamous signal dominates, so this is epithelial with an inflammatory component rather than myeloid contamination. Basal markers KRT5 and TP63 are present but weaker, so the cluster leans toward differentiated or suprabasal squamous cells. Diffuse M12, M55, M46 and M67 carry low-specificity background.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells, Cervical squamous tumor cells
metagene_label: Differentiated squamous epithelium, S100A8/A9-high + Squamous epithelium, KRT13/DSP-high
refine_reason: Wording differs from the shared 'Differentiated squamous epithelium' identity; aligned to the standard form with its S100A8/A9-high qualifier.

label: Activated fibroblasts (ECM-remodeling, SMC add-on)
description: Cluster 7 is a stromal population dominated by fibroblast extracellular-matrix signal: M4 (fibroblast ECM markers, COL3A1, SFRP1/4, COL6A1, LUM, PDGFRA) carries 18.5% of counts and is present in ~70% of cells at 40-fold enrichment, with M38 (activated/cancer-associated fibroblast ECM, POSTN, INHBA, MMP11) adding 6.1%. Top genes (SFRP4, COL3A1, SFRP1, COL6A1, COL5A1, AEBP1, LUM, COL1A2) confirm a fibroblast identity. Smooth-muscle/myofibroblast add-on M19 (DES, MYH11, ACTG2, TAGLN; 13.8%, in 38% of cells) and pericyte-like M25 (NOTCH3, RGS5) are minor and consistent with perivascular stroma. Diffuse low-specificity factors (M56, M95, M60, M63, M84, M64, M62, M90, M92) are background with no lineage; no meaningful immune or epithelial contamination.
cell_types: Fibroblasts, Cancer-associated fibroblasts, Smooth muscle / perivascular stroma
metagene_label: Fibroblast ECM markers + Smooth muscle / myofibroblast stroma

label: Endothelial cells (+ pericyte-like signal)
description: Cluster 8 is dominated by endothelial signal: M27 (Endothelial cells, 22.2% share, present in 66% of cells, fold >100x) carries canonical vascular genes VWF, PECAM1, EGFL7, RAMP2, FLT1, KDR, MMRN1, and the top genes confirm this (VWF, EPAS1, PECAM1, EGFL7, RAMP2, FLT1, KDR, MMRN1). M25 (pericyte-like NOTCH3/RGS5, 18.1% share, fold 72x) is a strong second component consistent with vessel-associated mural cells, so this may include endothelial-pericyte doublets or tight perivascular contact, though it is also present across most cells. Fibroblast (M4, 1.8%) and activated fibroblast (M38, 2.9%) signals are small and enriched only in minorities; the rest are diffuse, low-usage background factors (M95, M56, M60, M43, M64, M62) with no lineage.

label: Low-quality technical cluster (weak stromal signal)
description: Cluster 9 has no clear lineage. Its modeled counts are dominated by technical or diffuse factors: M30 (OR4F17/IST1, a probe or multi-mapping artifact, 13.1%) and M2 (SIGLEC15/GOLGA-family, 10.4%), with many small ambiguous background factors (M45, M56, M60, M8, M95, M22, M85). The only lineage signals are weak stromal ones: fibroblast ECM M4 (3.2%, fold 1.4), smooth muscle M19 (2.6%) and endothelial M27 (1.3%, fold 2.2), each present in only a small minority of cells. Weak keratin genes (KRT8, KRT18) in M30 add no convincing epithelial identity. The cluster is most likely low-quality or noise-dominated, with at most diffuse stromal signal.
cell_types: Low-quality cells, Fibroblasts, Smooth muscle cells, Endothelial cells

label: Ambiguous diffuse background cells
description: Cluster 10 has no clear lineage. Its metagenes are diffuse, low-specificity factors (M45, M2, M56, M22, M60, M8, M89, M99, M85) built from nuclear, RNA-processing and housekeeping genes, plus multi-copy or probe-artifact signals (M30 OR4F17/IST1, M2 GOLGA/NBPF families). The top genes (OR4F17, IST1, SMG1, ZNG1A, SIGLEC15, ITCH, CCNL1) show low fold changes and no coherent cell-type markers. A weak basal squamous signal appears in M10 (KRT15, ITGA2, DSC3) and M74 (TP63, ITGB4, LAMB3, COL7A1), but these are partial and present in only a few cells, so they are not enough to call the cluster epithelial. Most likely a low-quality or background-dominated cluster.
cell_types: Unassigned low-quality cells, Basal-like squamous epithelium

label: T cells (low quality, + stromal signal)
description: Low-quality cluster in which the technical metagenes (M30, M2, M8) take the largest shares, but the lymphoid signal is the most consistent lineage. M29 (T cell core: CD3E, TRAC, GIMAP7, BCL11B) is present in 28% of cells, and M83 (Treg) and M93 (CD8 cytotoxic) add support. TRAC, CD3E, GIMAP7, GIMAP4 and CD52 are among the top modeled genes. Stromal signal (M4 fibroblast ECM, M19 smooth muscle, with CCN2 and TAGLN among the top genes) is a weaker foreign component, roughly 8-9% combined, so it is noted as contamination. Confidence is low because the cluster's own signal is diffuse.
cell_types: T cells, CD8 T cells, Regulatory T cells

label: Squamous epithelial cells (technical-dominated, low quality)
description: Cluster 12 is small (279 cells) and dominated by technical factors: M30 (OR4F17/IST1, 12.7%) and M2 (SIGLEC15/GOLGA-family multi-copy genes, 9.8%) together make up about a quarter of modeled counts. The most consistent lineage signal is squamous epithelium: M0 (differentiated squamous, S100A8/A9-high, 7.0%, 1.6x), M5 (KRT13/DSP squamous, 3.1%), M15 (cornification genes IVL, SBSN, TGM1, KLK10, 1.3%, 2.5x) and M12 (PERP/CALML3/CLCA2). Top genes IVL, PGA3 and KLK-family genes support this, though the signal is weak and diffuse. Inflammatory NF-kB/TNF programs (M35, M36) and an IFN-gamma module (M49) are minor and shared across lineages, and no clear myeloid or stromal lineage is present, so no contaminant is called. Identity is tentative because technical metagenes dominate.

label: Squamous epithelial cells (hypoxic, differentiated)
description: Small cluster (20 cells) of squamous epithelial cells. The largest share is the differentiated squamous factor M6 (25%, SERPINB13, KRT13, DSG3, DSC2, NECTIN4, MUC4), with a hypoxia component (BHLHE40, SLC2A1, NDRG1). Basal keratinocyte factors M26 (TP63, KRT15, ITGA6, LAMB3) and M80 (TP63, COL17A1, CYP24A1) add basal-like identity, and M20 adds a glandular/secretory epithelial add-on. Diffuse factors M45, M30 and M87 (about 9%, 5% and 2%) are non-lineage background and are not used for the call. No clear foreign lineage is present; neutrophil S100A8/S100A9 signal is weak and non-specific.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells, Basal-like squamous epithelial cells
metagene_label: Squamous differentiation with hypoxia genes + Basal keratinocyte program

label: Fibroblasts (ECM-high, technical signal)
description: Small cluster of 45 cells whose lineage is best read as fibroblast/stroma. The fibroblast ECM factor M4 (COL3A1, SFRP4, SFRP1, COL6A1, TNC, LUM, PDGFRA) is enriched 5.1x and appears in 17.8% of cells, and the top enriched genes are mostly fibroblast ECM genes. Activated fibroblast M38 (POSTN, INHBA, MMP11) and smooth muscle-like M19 (DES, MYH11, TAGLN) add to the stromal picture. Technical metagenes M30 (OR4F17) and M2 dominate about 31% of counts and carry no identity, so the call rests on the stromal factors. Plasma cell (M3) and CD8/NK (M93) signals are small, about 1% each, and are ignored.

label: Fibroblasts (weak, diffuse background)
description: Small cluster of 36 cells with a weak fibroblast lean. M4 (fibroblast ECM, 7.0% share, fold 3.1x) is the most lineage-specific factor, and fibroblast genes COL3A1, SFRP4, SFRP1 and COL6A1 appear among the top modeled genes at 2.5-3x fold. Smooth muscle (M19, 3.2%) is a secondary stromal signal. Endothelial (M27, 4.0%) and Treg (M83, 4.2%) signals are small and carried by few cells, so they are treated as minor contamination. Most of the cluster's counts are diffuse housekeeping and nuclear factors (M77, M97, M50), so the identity is uncertain.
cell_types: Fibroblasts, Smooth muscle cells, Endothelial cells
metagene_label: ER protein translocation and glycosylation + NPM1/SMC1A/MED14-high

label: Basal squamous epithelial cells
description: Cluster 16 is a basal/reserve squamous epithelial population. The squamous basal theme is spread across several metagenes: M1 (KRT5, TP63, DSP; 9.1% share, 5x fold), M26 (KRT15, ITGA6, ITGB4, LAMB3; 6.1%), M10 (KRT15, ITGA2, DSC3; 5.6%, 8.3x), M80 (TP63, COL17A1, CYP24A1, IL1R2; 4.8%, 11.4x) and M74 (COL7A1, TP63, ITGB4; 4.9%). The top genes agree: KRT15, TNS4, TP63, ITGB4, ITGA2, LAMB3, CYP24A1 and IL1R2. KRT14 and SFN are not prominent, so the call is basal-like rather than full-thickness squamous. The remaining metagenes are diffuse, low-specificity or proliferation/stress programs (M17 S-phase, M36 NF-kB, M88 immediate early) with no competing lineage, so no clear contamination is present.
cell_types: Basal squamous epithelial cells, Squamous epithelial cells
metagene_label: Basal squamous epithelial cells + Basal keratinocyte program

label: Glandular epithelial/fibroblast mixture (low confidence)
description: Small, low-confidence cluster with no dominant lineage. Glandular/mucosal epithelial signal comes from M20 (6.2% share, fold 7.7, MUC1, CEACAM7, LYPD2, TMPRSS2, PRSS22 among the top genes), and stromal signal from M4 and M38 (fibroblast ECM, COL3A1, COL6A1/2, COL5A1, COL4A1; combined about 9%). The remaining metagenes are diffuse or technical (M2, M68, M30, M77) and do not define an identity. Epithelial and fibroblast signals are comparable, so the cluster is treated as a mixture rather than contamination of one lineage by the other.
metagene_label: Glandular secretory epithelium program + Fibroblast ECM markers

label: Cycling cells, histone and mitotic high (uncertain lineage)
description: A highly proliferative cluster dominated by cell-cycle programs: M7 (histone and mitotic core, 8.5% share, 9.9x fold), M17 (S-phase DNA replication, 7.3%), M39 (G2/M proliferation, 4.9x fold) and M24 (G1/S replication, 2.7x) together make up much of the cluster's counts, and the top genes (H1-5, H3C2, TPX2, MKI67, TOP2A, RRM2, CENPF, BIRC5) are cell-cycle genes. No lineage metagene is strongly enriched; squamous signals (M1 basal squamous 6.0%, 2.2x; M5 squamous add-on 1.1x) are weak and present in only a minority of cells, so the lineage is uncertain and the cluster is most likely cycling tumor or stromal cells in cervical cancer. Diffuse, weakly supported factors (M22, M16, M74, M12) add no clear identity.
cell_types: Cycling tumor cells, Cycling squamous epithelial cells
metagene_label: Cycling cells, histone and mitotic genes + S-phase DNA replication program

label: Regulatory T cells
description: Cluster 19 is a small T-lymphocyte cluster. M83 (regulatory T cell markers: FOXP3, CTLA4, IL2RA, ICOS, TIGIT; 7.2% share, 6.4x fold, in 38% of cells) and M29 (core T cell genes CD3E, TRAC, TRBC2, CD2, CD247; fold 2.9x) are enriched, and TRAC, CTLA4, CD3E and TRBC1 are among the top genes. Much of the modeled signal is technical (M30 OR4F17/IST1, M2, M8), so the call is less certain. Minor CD8 cytotoxic (M93) and fibroblast (M4) signals are at background levels and are not treated as contamination.
cell_types: Regulatory T cells, CD4 T cells, T cells
refine_reason: Same Treg identity as cluster 2 but worded 'T cell lineage'; standardized to 'Regulatory T cells'.

label: Tumor-associated macrophages (myeloid)
description: Myeloid cluster present in most cells, with the macrophage signature dominant. M14 (22.1% share, 79.6% of cells, 39x enriched) supplies the lineage with CLEC10A, FCGR2A, FGL2, CSF1R, LYZ and MS4A6A, and M59 (7.8%, 38x enriched) adds C1QA/C1QC, APOE, SPP1, CD163, CD14 and MMP9. Top genes (C1QA, C1QC, MMP9, APOE, CD14, CSF1R, STAB1, C1QB, FCER1G) fit tumor-associated macrophages, with some monocyte/dendritic-like signal from M14. Foreign signal is negligible (M1 basal squamous 1.8%, 0.6x fold) and is not treated as contamination.

label: Fibroblasts (+ IFN-gamma response, endothelial signal)
description: Small cluster (34 cells) whose largest modeled signal is an IFN-gamma response program (M49: CXCL10, CXCL9, STAT1, GBP1, TAP1, IDO1), but this program is shared across lineages and sits in only about 2 cells. The lineage-specific signal is stromal: fibroblast ECM (M4: COL3A1, COL6A1, SFRP4, COL5A1) and activated/cancer-associated fibroblast ECM (M38: POSTN, INHBA, COL4A1), with top genes COL3A1, COL4A1, COL6A1 and COL6A2 supporting this. Endothelial signal (M27: VWF, PLVAP, EGFL7, FLT1) is present at about 6% in a few cells, most plausibly doublets or spillover from neighboring vessels. CD8 cytotoxic signal (M93) is in about 12% of cells and is a minor immune component.
contaminants: Endothelial cells, CD8 cytotoxic T/NK cells
metagene_label: IFN-gamma response program + Fibroblast ECM markers

label: S-phase program + Squamous differentiation (low confidence)
description: Small, low-specificity cluster with no clear lineage. The largest share is the diffuse background factor M45 (26.8%, ambiguous), which carries most of the top genes (SMG1, ITCH, IST1, CCNL1). The most informative signals are the S-phase/DNA replication program M17 (7.5%, in 5.6% of cells) and the squamous differentiation, inflamed state M37 (6.0%, in 13.9% of cells, fold 9.2x), supported by CRNN and ERO1A among the top genes. Tumor-associated macrophage M59 (3.1%, fold 5.0x, with SIGLEC15 and ECM1 nearby) is a minor component, below the contamination threshold. Overall the cluster is weakly defined, so it is labelled ambiguous.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells, Cycling tumor cells, Tumor-associated macrophages

label: Fibroblasts with diffuse background (+ macrophage signal)
description: Cluster 23 is small (40 cells) and has no clearly dominant lineage. The most informative identity signal is a fibroblast ECM program (M4, 10.1% share, 4.5x enriched) with a weaker activated-fibroblast add-on (M38, 2.2%), supported by COL3A1, COL6A1, SFRP1/4 among the top genes. Diffuse housekeeping factors (M58, M64, about 26% combined) make up much of the signal and carry no lineage. A myeloid/TAM signal (M59, 7.3%, 11.6x) is concentrated in only about 2.5% of cells, consistent with a small subset or spillover; MMP9, C1QA and APOE also rank among the top genes. Smaller T cell (M29), IgG plasma cell (M3) and squamous (M0, M37) signals are likely background or spillover.
contaminants: Tumor-associated macrophages, T cells, IgG plasma cells

label: Fibroblast ECM + diffuse background (low confidence)
description: Small, heterogeneous cluster with no dominant lineage. The most informative signal is the fibroblast ECM factor M4 (11.2% share, 5.0x enriched; COL3A1, COL6A1/2, SFRP1/4, TNC, COL5A1), and COL3A1, SFRP1, SFRP4, COL6A1 and TNC are among the top modeled genes. However, M4 is strong in only about 2 of 39 cells, and most of the cluster is diffuse background (M58, M40, M94, M95, M46, M43). Minor lymphoid signal (M93 CD8 cytotoxic T/NK, M29 T cell, M34 B cell) is carried by only 1-3 cells each, so it reads as doublet or spillover contamination rather than the cluster's identity. Squamous/inflamed M37 is weak and shared with other epithelium.
contaminants: CD8 T/NK cells, T cells, B cells

label: IgG plasma cells (ER stress high)
description: Cluster 25 is dominated by plasma cell signal: M3 (IgG plasma cell markers, IGHG1/IGKC/XBP1/MZB1/DERL3/PRDM1, 14.1% share in 54% of cells), M31 (plasma cell immunoglobulin program, 5.8%, 24% of cells) and M23 (IGHG2-dominated plasma cell program, 1.8%, 7% of cells) together with the ER-stress/UPR secretory factor M53 (24.9% share in 80% of cells, a plasma cell-compatible secretory program). Top genes IGHG1, IGKC, IGHG3, IGLC7, IGHA1, MZB1, XBP1, DERL3 and POU2AF1 confirm antibody-secreting plasma cells, mainly IgG-class, with no B or T cell markers. Fibroblast (M4, 3.1%, 11% of cells) and diffuse splicing/RNA-processing factors are minor background. The cluster's large plasma cell share and its ER-stress program suggest a plasma cell subset with high secretory activity.
metagene_label: ER stress unfolded protein response + IgG plasma cell markers

label: Activated smooth muscle-like stroma (+ minor T cell signal)
description: Small cluster of 35 cells dominated by stromal signal: smooth muscle/myofibroblast program M19 (13.9% share, 9.2x fold, in 5.7% of cells) with fibroblast ECM M4 (6.0%) and activated fibroblast M38 (5.5%). Top genes DES, ACTG2, MYH11, TAGLN, MYLK, CCN2, SFRP4, GREM1, COL3A1, COL6A1 and COL5A1 support a stromal identity, leaning toward smooth muscle-like activated stroma. T-cell metagene M29 (7.4% share, in 5.7% of cells) is a minor signal, probably a few T cells or spillover, with no CD3 genes in the top list. Diffuse housekeeping metagenes (M64, M62, M76, M84) and a small squamous differentiation signal (M69, CRNN) are background. Because the cluster is tiny and the stromal signal is spread over several factors, confidence is medium.
metagene_label: Smooth muscle / myofibroblast stroma + T cell markers

label: Inflamed squamous epithelium (NF-kB/TNF high)
description: Tiny, low-confidence cluster of 50 cells. The largest factor is an NF-kB/TNF response program (M36, 12.3% share, fold 16x; TNFAIP2 is the top gene, with NFKB2, NFKBIZ, ZC3H12A, BIRC3). The lineage signal is weak but points to squamous epithelium: CRNN is a top gene at 4.5x, and M69 (CRNN-high differentiated squamous, 2.4%), M37 (squamous differentiation with inflamed genes, 3.8%) and M5 (squamous KRT13/DSP, 2.9%) together account for roughly 9% of counts. Minor T/cytotoxic signal (M29 4.0%, M93 2.0%) is present in only a few cells and is below contamination thresholds. Most other factors (M45, M12, M99, M58, M91, M85) are diffuse background with no lineage. Identity is therefore tentative.

label: Activated fibroblasts, ECM-remodeling (+ minor plasma signal)
description: Cluster 28 (27 cells) is a fibroblast/stromal cluster, dominated by M4 (41%, fold 18x, in 82% of cells: COL3A1, SFRP1/4, LUM, TNC, PDGFRA) and M38 (21%, fold 27x, activated/ECM-remodeling fibroblast state with POSTN, INHBA, MMP11, THBS2). Top genes (COL3A1, COL6A1/2, COL5A1/2, COL1A2, SFRP1/4, LUM, TNC, MMP11) confirm fibroblast identity. Minor plasma cell signal (M3, IGHG1, 3%, in 4% of cells) and small squamous/inflamed (M37, 4.5%) and myeloid/TAM (M59, 1.5%) components are low-level background or spillover and are not treated as the cluster's identity.
metagene_label: Fibroblast ECM markers + Activated fibroblasts, ECM-remodeling

label: Squamous epithelium/fibroblast mixture (low quality)
description: A very small cluster (29 cells) with no dominant lineage. The most enriched identity signal is squamous differentiation: M37 (FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL, KRT13; fold 10.4x) and M70 (MUC22, MAL, KRT78, SPRR-like genes), with the top genes FLG, CRNN and CRCT1 supporting it. Stromal signal is comparable in share: M4 fibroblast ECM (COL3A1, SFRP1, SFRP4), M19 smooth muscle/myofibroblast (DES, ACTG2, MYH11, TAGLN) and M75 stromal state, together about 14% of counts against about 10% for the epithelial metagenes. Most metagenes are diffuse housekeeping factors. Lymphoid metagenes (M83 Treg, M93 CD8/NK) are each under 5% and carried by only a few cells, so they are probably background or doublets. The label is a mixture call with low confidence.

contaminants: Fibroblast/smooth muscle stroma, Regulatory and cytotoxic T/NK cells (minor, few cells)

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium, inflamed (hypoxic)
description: Small cluster of 32 cells whose composition is dominated by diffuse, low-specificity factors (M79, M89, M50, M98, M92, M78, M62, M73) with no clear lineage. The most coherent identity signal is squamous epithelial differentiation: M37 (FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL, 11.6x fold), M15 (cornification genes IVL, SBSN, TGM1, KRTDAP) and M6 and M0 (SERPINB13, KRT13, DSG3, DSC2, KRT4, CD24) point to differentiated squamous epithelium, and top genes FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL and ERO1A agree. Fibroblast signal (M4) is present but weak (3.5% share, in 6% of cells). Basal KRT5/KRT14 are absent, so the call is a superficial squamous state, with medium confidence.

label: Superficial squamous epithelial cells (+ T cell and stromal signal)
